root_cause: Hot-path handling only raised aggregate risk. It did not express which downstream capabilities and regressions depend on a shared control-plane or manifest root, so critical cross-cutting changes could still rely on coarse full-suite coverage rather than explicit impact propagation.
prevention_rule: Maintain a versioned delivery dependency graph for shared roots. When a root changes, propagate its risk floor, downstream capabilities and named regressions into the Adaptive Delivery plan. Graph propagation may only add evidence or raise risk.
